title: Reap orphaned workerd for the harness vitest suite when it grows
description:
cloudflare's vitest suite has scripts/workerd-watchdog.mjs because a SIGKILLed vitest leaves workerd running forever (two dozen had piled up on this shared host). The harness suite is ~5 s today so the risk is small, but epic steps 6-7 add crash-resume and kill-mid-tool tests to it, which is exactly the shape that orphans workerd. When that lands, reuse the watchdog pattern for harness/vitest.config.ts.
